{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Display basic info
sales_df.info()

# Display first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()
print(top_rows)

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()
print('\nMissing values:\n', missing_values)

# Check unique values in key columns
print('\nUnique values in status column:\n', sales_df['status'].unique())
print('\nUnique values in order_type column:\n', sales_df['order_type'].unique())

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', duplicates)

# Summary statistics for revenue
print('\nRevenue summary:\n', sales_df['revenue'].describe())"}
